definitions.explanation: A student in the same grade or class.

examples.japanese: {同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I ran into a high school classmate.

examples.japanese: {同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
{同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧した。
examples.english: I studied together with a classmate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶりに→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I received a letter for the first time in a while from an elementary school classmate.

notes:
{同級生|どうきゅうせい} combines {同|どう} (same) + {級|きゅう} (grade) + {生|せい} (student).

USAGE:
- Refers to someone in the same school year, normally at the same school. The relationship keeps this name long after graduation, so ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同級生|どうきゅうせい} works equally well for a classmate you saw yesterday and one you last saw thirty years ago.
- It marks equal standing. Unlike ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧ and ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧, which encode who is senior, {同級生|どうきゅうせい} implies no ranking, and speech between {同級生|どうきゅうせい} is normally plain and casual.
- Used of other people far more than of oneself. To say who your own classmate is, the natural pattern is ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧, not a self-description.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同級生|どうきゅうせい}: classmate in the sense of same ⟦{学年|がくねん}→学年：00056_gakunen⟧ (grade level); the two need not share a homeroom
- ⟦クラスメート→クラスメート：20969_kurasumeeto⟧: classmate in the narrower sense of same ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧; a loanword, lighter and more school-bound
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: the workplace equivalent — someone who joined the company in the same year
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧: upperclassman
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: underclassman

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同級生|どうきゅうせい} (elementary school classmate)
- {同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (reunite with classmates)
